name: TopAI.tools
tagline: TopAI.tools organises its listings around community upvotes rather than paid placement, giving smaller tools a way to surface alongside established names. Each entry includes pricing, a short pitch, and tags, and users can filter by category or sort by newest, trending, or most upvoted. It also runs a 'launch' feature letting makers submit new tools for community feedback.
